title: Fourier restriction for positively curved surfaces

result.label: Fourier restriction for positively curved surfaces
result.statement: Proves the diagonal Fourier extension conjecture for positively curved surfaces in three dimensions. For every compact smooth positively curved surface R^3, including surfaces with boundary, the extension operator is bounded from L^p( ) to L^p( R^3) for every p > 3.
